newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer-Low investment due to reform uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer-Low investment due to reform uncertainty.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday that absence of growth in economic investment in Germany was due to uncertainty surrounding reform policies.
"The lack of growth in economic investment is due to reform policy uncertainty and not due to interest rate policy," the Bundesbank chief said.
Tietmeyer was speaking at a news conference after a regular policy-setting Bundesbank council meeting.
